name: Face drop
summary: Friends tap to drop each other's faces onto a shared pile, boop them and shake it.
useWhen: the chat is bored or goofing around and wants a toy for a story
a silly shared fidget with everyone's faces
dontUseWhen: anything that needs a decision, a plan or money

params.names: first names whose faces fall when the chat has no members to use, up to 8
